statuses.IMPLEMENTED: Working code with tests in this repository.
statuses.SIMULATION_VALIDATED: Implemented and scored against known simulated truth; says nothing about hardware or people.
statuses.EXPERIMENTAL: Implemented research code whose outputs are exploratory.
statuses.CONTRACT_ONLY: Interface contracts exist; the implementation is elsewhere or absent.
statuses.DESIGNED_NOT_BUILT: Design files exist; nothing has been fabricated or measured.
statuses.PLANNED: Described as a next step; no implementation.
statuses.SPECULATIVE: Architectural idea or hypothesis only; no implementation and no evidence.

layers.RESEARCH_EXTENSION: Bounded modules that attach through contracts and can be removed without breaking the core.

modules.summary: Versioned session record contract with provenance classes, lineage, decision time and input cutoff, execution chains, gaps, and CRC-32C.
not_claimed: CRC-32C and SHA-256 detect accidental change; they do not authenticate authorship.

modules.summary: Seeded physiological twin rendered through Rev B sensor and firmware-timing forward models; the digital test bench with known truth.
not_claimed: The twin is phenomenological and not fitted to any person.
Sensor timing, oscillator, and latency parameters are assumptions until measured.

modules.summary: Raw Rev B codes to beats, HR, HRV, respiration, apnea, SpO2, EDA tonic/phasic, motion, and IMU-observed haptic onset.
not_claimed: Scores measure agreement with the twin, not physiological, calibration, or clinical accuracy.

modules.summary: Temporally lawful controller with explicit quality gates, multi-system agreement, a clean-window precondition for starting (sustained means observed), hysteresis, stop-on-lost-observation, and snapshot/restore.
not_claimed: The arousal index is an engineering trigger, not a psychological measure.
The paced-breathing response is assumed by the twin.

modules.summary: Independent audit: re-derives the analysis and every derived session record from the raw bundle and device events, replays every decision, checks temporal lawfulness and execution chains, rebuilds the ledger, reports an explicit replay status.
not_claimed: Audit success shows internal consistency of a record, not that the record reflects the physical world.

modules.summary: Two-sided scenario families judged against hidden truth: most try to make the loop act when it should not (motion, contact loss, timing faults, sensor loss, feedback artifact, ambiguous physiology); one tries to make it fail to act when it should (a warranted state briefly obscured by motion).
not_claimed: Scenario success is conditional on the twin's disturbance models.

modules.summary: Deterministic validation and authorization boundary for AI- or human-proposed experiment protocols; executes approved protocols only against the twin.
not_claimed: No protocol can target hardware or a person from this repository.

modules.summary: circle-main and circle-ppg schematics and board outlines with archived KiCad ERC/DRC reports.
not_claimed: PCBs are not routed (open DRC allowlist).
No board has been fabricated, powered, or measured.
Component ratings are not assembled-system performance.

modules.summary: Pin map and initialization specification; the twin encodes the timing behavior firmware must reproduce.
not_claimed: No firmware exists in this repository.

modules.summary: Electrical and optical phantoms with known injected truth: the next evidence layer after simulation.
not_claimed: No phantom has been built.

modules.summary: Coupled-cavity simulator, blinded factorial scheduling, autocorrelation-aware permutation analysis, and phantom discrimination for the phi-geometry hypothesis.
not_claimed: Simulation shows behavior under the simulator's equations, not physical field behavior.
No chamber exists; no geometry effect has been measured.

modules.summary: Nested-sphere cavity with a dual-tetrahedron core, shown in diagrams and the 3D viewer.
not_claimed: A rendering shows intended geometry only; it is not evidence of any physical property.

modules.summary: Exploratory correlation search over coupled model fields, now reported against a circular-shift surrogate null with family-wise correction.
not_claimed: Discoveries are exploratory correlations; they do not establish causality, nonlocal effects, or anything about consciousness.

modules.summary: Translation-only 15-state bias-aiding estimator versus an unaided baseline on shared simulated IMU samples with known truth.
not_claimed: Not a hardware accuracy result.

modules.summary: Cold-atom interferometry, gravity gradiometry, and optical-clock fusion described as architecture only.
not_claimed: Nothing quantum is implemented or simulated by the benchmark.

modules.summary: Versioned manifest/result/analysis contracts for the external R.A.I.N. deliberation layer.
not_claimed: The R.A.I.N. launcher and executor live outside this repository.
